_description: Top-N categorical filter that ranks within a date range: the date filter must be a context filter, or Top N is computed over all dates first (Tableau Cloud accepted this exact shape)

date_filter._placement: worksheet > table > view, before the top-N filter

topn_filter._placement: worksheet > table > view, after the context filter

sort._placement: worksheet > table > view, after the filters
sort._description: Top N doesn't sort the bars; add a view-level sort too (see sort.json)

notes.why_context: Tableau applies Top N before ordinary dimension and measure filters. Without context='true' on the date filter, Top N picks the all-time top 10 and the date filter then removes most of them (for example, only 4 bars remain).
notes.slices: List both filtered fields under the view's <slices>.
notes.user_namespace: The user: attributes need xmlns:user='http://www.tableausoftware.com/xml/user' on the root <workbook>.
